## TRA Timeline

#### Disney / Hulu joint-venture combination and TRA execution

- 2025-01-06: 8-K announces Business Combination Agreement with The Walt Disney Company and Hulu, LLC
- 2025-08-07: DEFM14A filed (vote materials); TRA terms described narratively
- 2025-10-29: Business combination closes; Fubo Operations LLC ("Newco") formed with Hulu holding 70% / Fubo 30%; TRA executed and dated October 29, 2025; filed as Exhibit 10.2 to closing 8-K

## Explanation

FuboTV Inc. entered into its first Tax Receivables Agreement on October 29, 2025 at the closing of its Up-C-style joint venture with The Walt Disney Company and Hulu, LLC, which combined fuboTV's business with Disney's Hulu + Live TV business inside a newly formed Fubo Operations LLC ("Newco"). Hulu received 70% of Newco Units and voting Class B Common Stock at closing; Fubo retained 30% and the managing-member role. The TRA commits Fubo to pay Hulu (sole beneficiary) 70% of cash tax savings from increases in Newco's asset basis on future redemptions or exchanges of Newco Units for Class A Common Stock or cash, plus imputed interest on TRA payments. For payments attributable to Fubo's historic NOLs, the rate is the lesser of 70% and Hulu's current ownership percentage of Newco at the time of NOL utilization, so NOL-tranche payments scale down if Hulu's ownership later falls. The contract is atypical in that it is not accelerated by a post-closing change of control of Fubo. No TRA liability has been recognized as of the March 31, 2026 10-Q because Fubo does not expect to use historical NOLs and no Newco Unit redemptions have triggered basis step-ups. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
